title: HeroicLoot
tagline: HeroicLoot is a top-down 3D rpg game, leveraging Loot NFT's as free starting characters.
description: Heroic Loot is an 3D play to earn blockchain game. It is being built on Polygon for it’s near instant transaction speed and almost zero fees. The game will be playable in web browser. All in-game starting Hero and equipment is generated by Loot project based on wallet address. Player’s stats can improve with level up.
how_its_made: It is being built on Polygon for it’s near instant transaction speed and almost zero fees. The project is developed using Unity Editor, with a few integration points with Ethereum, including a few REST API calls to write to Polygon Matic Testnet, and Nethereum client to read blockchain data.
